questions.subject: Polity
questions.question:
With reference to the Constitution of India, consider the following statements:
1. The Preamble is an integral part of the Constitution.
2. The Preamble can be amended under Article 368 without altering its basic structure.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

explanations.content: Kesavananda Bharati case 1973 established Preamble is integral part.
explanations.author: UPSC

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: In India, which of the following is/are the main objective(s) of the Reserve Bank of India's Inflation Targeting Framework?
options: To maintain price stability while keeping in mind the objective of growth
To fix the exchange rate of Indian Rupee against US Dollar
To eliminate fiscal deficit of the Central Government
questions.correctAnswer: To maintain price stability while keeping in mind the objective of growth

explanations.content: Section 45ZA of RBI Act 1934 specifies price stability alongside growth.
explanations.author: RBI
